Pose: stagger backward toward left, torso recoiling, bent knees, equipment retained, pained but alive. Face screen right, shallow three-quarter view. Virtual grid: a single portrait cell, invisible 15% safety margins on ALL four sides. Every hair tip, weapon tip, boot and effect stays strictly inside this safety rectangle; full body visible, no cropping. Exactly two connected arms and two connected hands, normal wrist and elbow articulation and anatomically correct thumbs. Keep both hands readable, no ghost limbs, duplicate fingers or disembodied limbs. Clean outlined painted game art matching reference, restrained effect, no other people, labels, guide lines, checkerboard, backdrop, floor or shadow. Genuine transparent alpha. Highest available native portrait resolution, target 2048x2736. Only change articulated pose, preserve the reference identity and small-head proportions exactly.
